name: gifshooter
description: Paint with animated gifs on a shared big screen, using your phone as a trackpad. Serverless WebRTC via public Nostr relays.

scripts.build:assets: npm run generate:gifs && npm run generate:logo && npm run build:sprites
scripts.test:browsers: vite build && python3 tests/browsers.py; status=$?; vite build && exit $status
